new_roles.title: Regional Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

new_roles.title: Director of Operations homecare
new_roles.description:
Royal Faith Homecare Agency is seeking an organized, compassionate, and motivated professional to coordinate caregiver, schedules, maintain reliable client coverage, support agency growth through marketing, community outreach, and referral development.The Director of Operations, Homecare, leads the systems and teams that support safe, reliable care in patients’ homes. You’ll guide operational and strategic management, align resources with organizational priorities, and partner across clinical and administrative functions. Your impact: By strengthening care operations and performance improvement, you help patients and families receive coordinated, dependable homecare.

The ideal candidate will have strong adminstrative and communication skills, understand the importance of dependable home care services, and feel comfortable building relationships with healthcare professionals, social workers, case managers, and community organizations.

As a Home Director Of Operations, you’ll help clients access organized, responsive care by coordinating communication, records, and administrative support. You’ll manage client information with care, assist with scheduling and inquiries, and help ensure documentation follows applicable health regulations and privacy requirements. Your impact: By keeping care details accurate and communication clear, you help clients and care teams stay informed and better prepared for each step of service.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate client inquiries, appointments, and care-related administrative tasks.

* Care Coordination and Scheduling

* create and maintain weekly caregiver schedules

* Match Caregivers with clients based on qualifications, availability, and client needs.

* Handle call-outs, missed shifts, late arrivals, and replacement coverage.

* Communicate schedule changes to clients, caregivers and authorized representative

* monitor scheduled, completed, missed, and cancelled visits.

* Track authorized service hours and notify management of discrepancies.

* Monitor authorization expiration dates and alert the appropriate staff.

* Communicate with clients and care teams by phone and other appropriate channels; route questions to the right person.

Marketing and Community Outreach

* Promote Royal Faith Homecare Agency's approved services to appropriate referral sources.

* Visit hospitals, rehabilitation facilities, medical offices, senior centers, veteran-serving organizations, and community organization.

* Build professional relationships with social workers, discharge planners, case managers, and other referral partners.

* Explain the agency Veteran, Private Pay homecare services and referral process accurately.

* Distribute approved brochures, business cards, and marketing materials.

* Assist with community events, networking meetings, and outreach campaigns.

Skills

* Medical office or general office experience; medical administrative support experience is helpful.

* Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) and EHR management, patient management software, and Microsoft Office.

* Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance, and health regulation policies is preferred.

* Strong customer service, phone communication, and client communication skills.

* Accurate typing, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.

**Duties**

* Lead daily homecare operations, setting priorities and monitoring service quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Direct managers and teams, building accountability through clear managerial communication, team leadership, and executive leadership.
* Partner with medical and nursing leaders on care delivery, staffing, and medical management.
* Lead Performance Improvement (PI) initiatives and collaborate cross-functionally to address operational challenges and support strategic goals.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience in healthcare management, operations management, and operational management, including leadership of teams and managers.
* Nursing leadership experience and a background in medical leadership or medical management are important for guiding homecare services.
* Knowledge of health regulation policy and Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO) standards, with the ability to apply requirements to operations.
* Strong strategic management, executive leadership, team leadership, and managerial communication skills.
* Ability to manage healthcare finances and work effectively across clinical, administrative, and operational functions.

Pay: From $19.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oxford, AL 36203

new_roles.title: Director of Facilities and Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Facilities & Operations serves as a key member of the leadership team and is responsible for the stewardship, maintenance, safety, and operational excellence of the retreat center’s older buildings, grounds, infrastructure, and support services. Guided by Franciscan values of simplicity, compassion, peace, and reverence for creation, this role ensures that the physical environment reflects a spirit of hospitality, beauty, and care for all who visit.

The Director oversees facilities maintenance, grounds management, capital improvement projects, compliance, vendor relationships, safety compliance, and operational support services. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader with experience in facilities management, construction, property management, or building operations who can balance strategic planning with day-to-day operational oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities & Property Management**

· Provide leadership and oversight for the maintenance, repair, and improvement of all buildings, grounds, utilities, and infrastructure across the retreat center campus.

· Develop and implement preventative maintenance programs to ensure the longevity and reliability of facilities and equipment.

· Develop and maintain a multi-year facilities and building assessment plan with replacement forecast (roofs, HVAC, water/septic, electrical, roadways).

· Manage rural site systems including well, septic/on-site wastewater, water treatment, propane, backup power/generators, private roads, and irrigation, ensuring resilience to wildfire, storm, and extended-outage conditions.

· Coordinate and supervise facility improvement projects, renovations, and construction activities from planning through completion.

· Conduct regular inspections of buildings and grounds and establish priorities for repairs and upgrades.

· Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.

**Construction & Capital Projects**

· Manage capital improvement projects, including budgeting, contractor selection, scheduling, and quality control.

· Serve as the primary liaison with architects, engineers, contractors, inspectors, and vendors.

· Develop project scopes, obtain bids, review contracts, and monitor project progress.

· Maintain long-range facility and infrastructure improvement plans aligned with organizational priorities.

· Evaluate facility systems and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, sustainability, and guest experience.

**Operations Leadership**

· Oversee operational support functions including maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and facility readiness for retreats and events.

· Develop and implement operational procedures to ensure efficient, consistent, and safe facility operations.

· Coordinate logistics to support retreat programs, guest groups, and special events.

· Ensure facilities are prepared and functioning properly to support all scheduled activities.

**Team Leadership**

· Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and support staff.

· Foster a collaborative culture of accountability, stewardship, and service.

· Establish work schedules, assign priorities, and ensure effective staff coverage.

· Promote safe work practices and ongoing professional development.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

· Assist in the development and management of facility, operations, and capital budgets.

· Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

· Solicit and evaluate vendor proposals and negotiate service agreements.

· Manage relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure quality work and cost-effective solutions.

**Guest & Retreat Experience**

· Ensure retreat guests experience a safe, clean, comfortable, and welcoming environment.

· Collaborate with retreat and program staff to align facility operations with guest and event needs.

· Address facility-related concerns promptly and professionally.

**Administrative Responsibilities**

· Maintain accurate records related to maintenance activities, inspections, projects, vendor contracts, and regulatory compliance.

· Prepare reports and recommendations regarding facility conditions, capital needs, and operational improvements.

· Support organizational initiatives and special events as requested.

**Qualifications Required**

· Minimum of 2 years of experience in facilities management, construction management, property management, building operations, or a related field.

· Demonstrated experience supervising maintenance personnel, contractors, or operational teams.

· Strong knowledge of building systems, preventative maintenance practices, safety procedures, and facility operations.

· Proven project management skills, including budgeting, scheduling, and contractor oversight.

· Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

· Ability to prioritize multiple projects and respond effectively to operational needs.

**Preferred**

· Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

· Experience in hospitality, retreat centers, camp and conference centers, educational campuses, nonprofit organizations, or mission-driven environments.

· Background in commercial construction, renovation projects, or capital improvement management with knowledge of older infrastructure.

· Knowledge of and/or desire to learn water system operation.

· CPR/First Aid certification.

**Work Environment**

· Requires regular physical presence throughout the retreat center campus.

· Frequent walking across buildings and grounds, including uneven outdoor terrain.

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform occasional physical inspections of facilities and equipment.

· Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, and emergency response situations as operational needs require.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

identity_held_roles.title: IT Director of Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
**ABOUT ETHOS & THE OPPORTUNITY**

Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company focused on delivering better data, technology, and insights that help our clients make better decisions. We are continuing to invest in our technology organization and are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help scale how software is built, tested, and delivered.

We are seeking a **full-time Director of Quality Assurance** to own software quality across Ethos, overseeing an outsourced QA team and the processes, tooling, environments, and metrics that prevent defects from reaching production. Our ideal candidate is an experienced, results-driven QA leader who will establish a consistent defect lifecycle, reduce defect aging, implement effective root cause analysis and preventive measures, and improve the reliability of test environments. Within their first year, they will standardize QA tools and processes, integrate AI-based solutions into daily QA operations and performance tracking, and establish a comprehensive KPI framework that drives measurable improvements in software quality, efficiency, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead Outsourced QA Operations:** Direct the day-to-day activities of an outsourced QA team of 8 to10 resources, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and accountability for quality deliverables.
* **Manage Vendor Performance:** Oversee vendor agreements, SLAs, staffing, onboarding, and performance evaluations. Address performance gaps through corrective action and ensure effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Drive Defect Management:** Establish and enforce standardized defect tracking, classification, prioritization, and resolution processes. Lead regular defect triage with engineering and product teams to manage backlogs and identify quality risks.
* **Prevent Production Issues:** Lead structured root cause analysis of production defects, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement preventive measures through improved test coverage, regression testing, and quality gates.
* **Oversee Test Environments:** Partner with DevOps to maintain stable, production-representative QA, staging, and UAT environments, including configuration standards, test data management, and environment availability.
* **Define QA Strategy & Standards:** Develop and continuously improve QA processes across manual, automated, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to strengthen quality and consistency.
* **Advance Test Automation:** Evaluate and implement QA tools and automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and release reliability.
* **Leverage AI-Enabled QA Tools:** Apply AI-based solutions to test generation, defect classification, failure analysis, workload management, and performance monitoring. Evaluate emerging tools and implement solutions that deliver measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate security and accuracy controls.
* **Establish Quality KPIs:** Define and monitor performance metrics, including defect escape rates, resolution times, automation coverage, recurring production incidents, test effectiveness, and vendor SLA adherence.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Produce monthly quality reports and quarterly reviews for the VP of Engineering and CTO, translating performance data into actionable insights, risks, trends, and recommendations.
* **Support Release Readiness:** Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT Delivery Leads, and Technical Product Owners to integrate QA into sprint and release planning, assess release quality, and recommend readiness for deployment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (required).

**Required Experience:**

* 8 to 10 years of progressively greater responsibility in software quality assurance.
* 3 to 4 years in a QA management role leading teams and managers.
* Proven expertise in defect lifecycle management, root cause analysis, and preventive quality practices.
* Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining test environments and test data management practices.
* Strong working knowledge of QA tooling, such as test management (e.g., Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), defect tracking (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps), and automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).
* Practical experience using AI-based tools in QA or team management, and enthusiasm for expanding their use.
* Experience defining QA KPIs and producing executive-level monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Performance, security, or API testing, and a regulated-industry background.
* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced or Test Manager, CSQE, or similar.
* Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

**WORKING AT ETHOS**

This is a 100% remote U.S.-based role, offering the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to a collaborative leadership team. Our ideal candidate is available during EST standard business hours. Occasional travel may be required for quarterly or annual leadership meetings and company events.

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.**

**Benefits include:** Paid Time Off and Sick Time **|** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance **|** Short-Term + Long-Term Disability Insurance + Life Insurance **|** 401(k) Matching **|** Employee Referral Bonus Program

At Ethos, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, shape the future of our engineering organization, and help build the systems and processes that support our next stage of growth. **To learn more about Ethos, visit our website:** https://ethosrisk.com/about-us/

*Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. This starts from day one. existing_roles.description:
Are you a quality leader who enjoys building systems, developing teams, and creating a culture of continuous improvement? Advantic Building Group is seeking a Director of Quality to lead enterprise-wide quality strategy, establish a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), drive ISO 9001 certification efforts, and partner with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the future of quality within a growing organization.

At Advantic Building Group, we design, fabricate, and install innovative Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) structural systems that help our customers build smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

But what truly sets Advantic apart isn’t just what we build — it’s **how** we work and **who** we work with.

We're a team that values ownership, camaraderie, and curiosity. We roll up our sleeves, tackle challenges together, and support one another along the way. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a quality leader who shares those values and can help strengthen the culture we've built while establishing the systems, processes, and accountability necessary to deliver exceptional quality outcomes for our customers.

**Why Join Advantic?**

* Lead the development of a scalable enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS)
* Drive Advantic's ISO 9001 certification journey
* Influence quality across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations
* Build and develop a growing quality organization
* Partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategic initiatives
* Make a visible impact on customer success, operational excellence, and company growth

  

**Role Summary**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership for quality across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, assembly, and field operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing Advantic Building Group's quality strategy, building a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), leading ISO 9001 certification efforts, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This leader partners closely with operations, engineering, supply chain, and project teams to reduce defects, improve process performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support the company's growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership and Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute a quality roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational risks, and manufacturing and construction requirements; set annual objectives, priorities, and resource needs, including staffing, inspection equipment, and quality technology.
* Report quality performance, emerging risks, and cost of poor quality (scrap, rework, field repairs, returns, warranty) to senior leadership with clear owners, deadlines, and escalation expectations, and partner with Operations and Delivery to reduce it.

**Quality Management Systems (QMS) & ISO 9001 Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Advantic's Quality Management System (QMS), while leading ISO 9001 certification readiness, certification audits, surveillance audits, and recertification activities.
* Build a scalable, practical Quality Management System that enables operational consistency, supports growth, improves customer satisfaction, and achieves ISO 9001 certification.
* Govern document, configuration, and revision control across engineering drawings, submittals, production information, and field documentation, and ensure quality records are reliable and accessible across ERP, MES, and document systems with defined data ownership.

**Manufacturing Quality, Process Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, and release controls for incoming materials, in-process fabrication, final assembly, packaging, and pre-shipment verification, ensuring products conform to approved drawings, engineering requirements, customer specifications, and applicable contractual and industry requirements.
* Partner with Operations on specification review, design reviews, process risk assessments, first-build validation, and readiness for new or changed products and processes; coordinate qualified technical resources when specialized expertise is needed.
* Define traceability, inspection records, measuring equipment controls, calibration, and measurement method validation appropriate to risk and application.
* Establish controls for FRP materials and structural assemblies, including storage, handling, fabrication, and special processes.

**Corrective Actions, Root Cause Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Lead the enterprise nonconformance and corrective action process, including containment, material disposition, root cause analysis, escalation management, and verification of corrective action effectiveness across internal, supplier, customer, and field-related issues.
* Exercise authority under approved procedures to quarantine material, hold shipments, or stop affected work when conformity is in question; coordinate technical dispositions and obtain required customer approval for concessions or deviations, while maintaining independence of quality decisions.

**Supplier, Subcontractor, & Field Quality Management**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier qualification, approval, audit, and performance monitoring, including quality requirements for outsourced services and subcontracted work, and maintain approval status in the approved supplier system.
* Ensure certifications, traceability, inspection evidence, and customer requirements are flowed down to suppliers and verified.
* Lead supplier corrective actions and improvement plans, and support cost recovery within established commercial authority.
* Develop the field quality program for construction management and data center white space work, including project quality plan templates, inspection and test plan requirements, hold and witness points, and documentation standards that on-site QC managers must follow.
* Set expectations for, train, and hold on-site QC managers accountable to the program through project kickoffs, periodic field audits, and review of inspection records, field non-conformances, and punch list and turnover documentation.
* Serve as the escalation point for field quality issues and the senior quality contact for customers and third-party inspectors during audits and handover.

  

**Performance Measures**

* Establish baselines, targets, and reporting definitions with leadership. Measures include first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, nonconformance recurrence and closure time, corrective action effectiveness, supplier performance, customer complaints, field deficiencies, audit completion, calibration compliance, and progress against the quality roadmap.

  

**People Leadership and Shared Accountability**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development of quality personnel, with training matrices, competency expectations, and succession plans.
* Partner with operational leaders to build quality awareness across the organization, and hold process owners accountable through agreed governance and escalation, reinforcing that each department owns the quality of its work.
* Model Ownership, Camaraderie, and Curiosity through clear expectations, respectful challenge, and consistent follow-through.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including five or more years leading a quality team or function in manufacturing or a comparable technical environment.
* Demonstrated success building, implementing, or significantly improving Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Experience leading ISO 9001 implementation, certification readiness, and managing internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Proven results developing people, leading change across departments, and reducing defects, repeat failures, or quality-related costs.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and inspection requirements; practical knowledge of measurement systems, traceability, process controls, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience using ERP, MES, electronic quality systems, or comparable tools to establish dependable workflows and actionable reporting.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, frontline employees, and senior leaders; make sound decisions under pressure; and resolve competing quality, schedule, and business priorities.

  

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with FRP or composite products, structural fabrication, engineered assemblies, construction quality, or mission-critical and data center projects.
* Experience connecting manufacturing quality with field installation, subcontractor oversight, customer acceptance, and project turnover.
* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or CQA certification; ISO 9001 lead auditor qualification; or Lean Six Sigma training with demonstrated application.

  

**Physical demands**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively through speaking and listening. The role typically involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move objects up to 15 pounds.

*Advantic Building Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to develop high performing products to study genomics with unprecedented flexibility and quality that enable researchers to better understand biology for the improvement of global health. We have built a highly efficient product-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness.

We are seeking an experienced **Director of Quality** to lead Element Biosciences' Quality function and ensure the continued effectiveness, scalability, and maturity of our Quality Management System (QMS) as the company expands its research-use and regulated product portfolio.

Reporting directly to the Chief Supply Chain Officer, the Director of Quality will serve as Element's senior Quality leader, independent Quality authority, and Management Representative for the company's ISO 13485 Quality Management System. This role will have responsibility for Quality Systems, Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Quality Control and incoming inspection, Document Control, audit and inspection readiness, and product and process quality.

The Director will build upon Element's existing quality system foundation and partner closely with Product Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Service, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and other functions to ensure that products and processes meet applicable quality requirements throughout the product lifecycle. The Director will promote a culture in which quality requirements are incorporated early, risks are identified and addressed proactively, and quality systems enable both compliance and efficient execution.

If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Lead Element's Quality function and QMS, establishing Quality strategy, policies, objectives, metrics, and priorities and ensuring continued compliance with applicable quality system regulations, standards, company policies, and procedures
* Serve as Management Representative for the ISO 13485 QMS, ensuring required QMS processes are established and maintained, reporting QMS performance and improvement needs to executive management, and promoting awareness of applicable quality and regulatory requirements throughout the organization
* Serve as the company's senior Quality authority, providing independent judgment and escalation on significant product, process, supplier, and quality system risks and leading Management Review, CAPA, nonconformance, complaint, change control, document control, and continuous improvement processes
* Lead product and process quality throughout the lifecycle, including design controls, risk management, verification and validation, new product development, design transfer, manufacturing readiness, sustaining changes, incoming/in-process/final quality controls, and product release
* Own Supplier Quality, including supplier qualification and monitoring, risk classification, quality agreements, supplier audits, corrective actions, and escalation of significant supplier related risks
* Lead organizational inspection and audit readiness, including FDA inspections, ISO certification and surveillance audits, notified body QMS audits, customer audits, and other Quality-related assessments, and ensure timely and effective resolution of findings
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs on regulated product lifecycle and post-market activities, with Quality responsible for investigation, root cause analysis, quality risk assessment, containment, and corrective action, and Regulatory Affairs responsible for regulatory impact assessments, reporting, notifications, and market authorization implications
* Build and develop a high performing Quality organization, establishing clear accountability, decision rights, scalable processes, and a culture of proactive risk management, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and cross-functional partnership

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences, chemistry, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred
* Typically 15+ years of progressively responsible Quality experience within medical devices, IVDs, life science tools, or similarly regulated products, including significant leadership responsibility
* Demonstrated experience leading and scaling Quality organizations and ISO 13485 Quality Management Systems, including experience serving as or working closely with a Management Representative
* Deep working knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA quality system requirements, ISO 14971, design controls, CAPA, complaint handling, change control, supplier quality, validation, and auditing principles
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, ISO/notified body audits, and other external Quality audits, including management of findings and corrective actions
* Strong experience supporting product development, design transfer, manufacturing, and commercial product lifecycle processes; experience with complex instrumentation, IVD, NGS, software enabled products, or SaMD preferred
* Strong risk-based judgment, executive communication skills, and demonstrated ability to influence technical and business leaders while maintaining appropriate Quality independence and authority
* Self-directed, pragmatic, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities; demonstrated commitment to developing people and organizational capability
* ASQ certifications such as CQE, CQA, or CMQ/OE are preferred

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.

**Location:**

* San Diego (on-site)

**Travel:**

* Willingness to travel up to approximately 10% of the time

**Job Type:**

* Full-time, Exempt

**Base Compensation Pay Range:**

* $152,000 - $215,000

*In addition to base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, discretionary annual bonus, no cost health insurance plans, 401k with company match, and flexible paid time off.*

  

*Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.*

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
Position Title: Quality Manager

Reports To: Plant Manager

Position Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) and overall product quality performance. This role focuses on ensuring compliance with AS9100 requirements, driving corrective actions and maintaining consistent quality standards across all operations.

The primary focus of this role is ownership of the QMS, proactive quality leadership and ensuring quality standards are effectively executed in both production and administrative processes.

Project Prioritization & Scope

· Ensure the Quality Management System is maintained, compliant and effectively implemented across the organization.

· Prioritize and drive corrective actions related to customer complaints, internal defects and supplier issues.

· Ensure timely completion of PPAPs, first article inspections and other customer-required quality deliverables.

· Balance time between production floor engagement and administrative quality responsibilities based on business needs.

· Proactively identify quality risks in production and implement containment and corrective actions.

· Prioritize improvement activities based on quality performance metrics, including customer returns, scrap and supplier performance.

· Coordinate with Production, Engineering and other departments to address quality-related risks and issues.

· Ensure nonconforming material is properly controlled, documented and dispositioned in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

· Own and maintain the AS9100 Quality Management System, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

· Lead internal audits and coordinate external audits, including customer and registrar audits.

· Monitor quality performance and address issues impacting product quality in real time.

· Communicate quality performance, risks and significant issues to leadership in a timely manner.

· Perform hands-on inspection of parts as needed to verify quality standards and reinforce expectations.

· Engage with production employees through brief training and coaching conversations to improve quality awareness and execution.

· Lead and drive corrective actions (8D, CARs, SCARs) across departments, ensuring timely completion and effectiveness.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for customer quality issues and responses.

· Oversee supplier performance, including quality, corrective actions and on-time delivery.

· Own, monitor and drive improvement of key quality performance metrics including customer returns, internal scrap and supplier performance.

· Support or perform technical validation activities such as dimensional inspection and laser scanning as required.

· Ensure inspection processes (incoming, in-process, final) are effective and consistently executed.

Implementation & Sustainment

· Ensure quality processes and standards are consistently followed and sustained across all departments.

· Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and escalate when issues are not resolved.

· Verify that process changes, corrective actions and improvements are properly implemented and maintained.

· Ensure documentation and records within the QMS remain current, accurate and controlled.

Quality System & Process Execution Focus

· Oversee adherence to quality standards across all manufacturing processes.

· Monitor process compliance and identify deviations from established quality requirements.

· Ensure nonconforming material is clearly identified, segregated and controlled.

· Prevent shipment of nonconforming product through effective inspection and process controls.

Training & Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Provide training, coaching and guidance to employees regarding quality standards and expectations.

· Conduct brief, on-the-floor interactions to reinforce quality awareness and correct behaviors.

· Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance and other departments to resolve quality issues.

· Work with Purchasing and suppliers to address supplier-related quality concerns.

· Drive accountability for quality performance across all departments.

· Conduct regular team communication meetings and employee development discussions to support accountability, alignment and performance.

Role Scope & Responsibilities

The following clarifies the scope of this role in relation to other functions within the organization:

· This role owns the Quality Management System and is accountable for its effectiveness and compliance with AS9100 requirements.

· This role is responsible for proactively identifying, initiating and driving corrective actions across all departments.

· This role owns quality outcomes and is responsible for ensuring completion of quality-related activities, regardless of which function performs the work.

· This role is responsible for maintaining a consistent presence on the production floor to verify quality and reinforce standards.

· This role is expected to proactively identify, escalate and drive resolution of quality risks without requiring direction from others.

· This role supports production through quality oversight but does not own production output or scheduling.

· This role is responsible for driving accountability to quality standards across all departments and providing leadership, direction and oversight to quality personnel as organizational needs evolve.

· This role supports product validation activities such as PPAP and inspection but does not own process design, which is the responsibility of the Process Engineer.

· This role is accountable for ensuring nonconforming material processes are followed but relies on cross-functional support for execution of material movement and disposition actions.

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you okay with working in an office setting and on the production floor?

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* Quality audits: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Required)

Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. ### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

### **How You Will Help**

existing_roles.title: Director of Technical Operations

### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
  
  
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

  

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements**  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.
* Capable of occasional travel as required by duties, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in diverse locations.
* Capable of operating a computer and other office productivity machinery, including a calculator, copy machine, and printer.

**Working Conditions**

At Pacific Seafood your base wage is only a portion of your overall compensation package. We invest in our Team Members through a comprehensive and attractive total rewards package, including but not limited to:

existing_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.

* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.
* Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Oversee the work of others.
* Assist with coordination of adherence to organizational goals, operating policies, and budgetary guidelines.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**  
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off

* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

* Potential for growth within organization
* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

Reporting to the VP Quality Regulatory Affairs, the Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance will be tasked with ensuring Quality standards are met or exceeded in all facets of the multi-site operation. He/she will partner internally in the development and implementation of new or adjusted quality standards, policies, and procedures, as required at Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ.

* Medium sized company – not too big, not too small – just enough to get things done and see your impact.

**Travel Requirements**

**Office Environment**

This position is based in an office environment and is primarily sedentary in nature. It requires regular use of standard office equipment, including computers, phones, photocopiers, scanners, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Some roles may involve wearing a headset and sustained computer use for 8 or more hours per day. Employees may be required to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods, and occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

existing_roles.description:
**Director, New Product Introduction (NPI) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)**

Round Rock, Texas | Onsite | Full-Time

**Reports to:** CFO/CEO

**Works closely with:** Director of Operations/Engineering/R&D, Quality, Purchasing, Production, Program Management and external suppliers

**Travel:** Approximately 25%-35%, primarily to supplier locations

**Role structure:** Hands-on director role; initially an individual contributor leading cross-functional work

**Role Summary**

The Director of NPI & PLM leads the transition of new and modified products from development into stable production. The role coordinates product documentation, supplier readiness, pilot builds, production handoff and lifecycle changes across Ametrine and its manufacturing partners.

This position is focused on practical execution. The Director will work directly with cut-and-sew partners and other suppliers to ensure products can be produced repeatedly at the required quality, capacity and schedule. The role also helps develop alternate sources and contingency plans across fabric, metallization, printing, DWR treatment and cut-and-sew operations.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction**

* Maintain the NPI schedule for new products, product changes and manufacturing transfers.
* Coordinate requirements, design release, sourcing, prototype builds, pilot production, validation and production handoff.
* Use clear stage gates, owners, due dates and readiness checklists.
* Identify schedule, supplier, material, quality and capacity risks early and drive actions to closure.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, open decisions, risks and next steps.

**Prototype-to-Production Transfer**

* Work with Engineering and R&D to review designs for manufacturability and production readiness.
* Prepare or coordinate BOMs, routings, work instructions, technical packages, inspection points and packaging requirements.
* Lead prototype, pilot and first-production builds at Ametrine and supplier locations.
* Capture lessons learned and ensure changes are reflected in released documentation.
* Confirm that Operations and suppliers are ready before a product is released to routine production.

**Cut-and-Sew and Supplier Readiness**

* Work onsite with cut-and-sew partners to establish and improve production methods.
* Review patterns, sewing specifications, fixtures, templates, work instructions and inspection requirements.
* Assess supplier labor, equipment, training, floor space, quality controls and available capacity.
* Develop practical ramp plans and verify production rates through actual builds.
* Support supplier training and resolve manufacturability, throughput and quality issues during launch.
* Track supplier actions and escalate missed commitments or unsupported plans.

**Product Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain control of released BOMs, specifications, approved materials, suppliers, routings and product revisions.
* Coordinate engineering changes and assess their impact on inventory, suppliers, schedule, testing and customer requirements.
* Ensure the correct product configuration is used for each order and customer.
* Support PLM process and system improvements, including appropriate integration with ERP/MRP.
* Maintain orderly lifecycle records from product introduction through sustainment and retirement.

**Supply-Chain Resilience**

* Maintain a process-level supply-chain map covering fabric, metallization, printing, DWR, cut and sew, accessories and final delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks, long-lead items, single-source dependencies and supplier-capacity risks.
* Develop and qualify alternate sources where practical.
* Create contingency plans for specialized processes that cannot be economically dual-sourced.
* Coordinate source qualification with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering and Quality.
  

**Quality and Process Control**

* Partner with Quality to define process controls, inspection requirements and first-article expectations.
* Support supplier qualification, process reviews, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor first-pass yield, defects, rework and launch-related issues.
* Ensure production methods remain consistent with approved documentation and customer requirements.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Lead NPI work through influence across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Purchasing and suppliers.
* Maintain clear owners, deadlines and escalation paths.
* Coordinate with the Director of Operations so new-product timelines and supplier readiness are aligned with the production plan.
* Support communication and coordination between Ametrine Inc. and Ametrine Ltd. where product development activities overlap.

**Success Measures**

* NPI milestones completed on schedule
* Prototype-to-pilot and pilot-to-production cycle time
* Supplier readiness and capacity verification completed before launch
* Percentage of critical supply-chain nodes with an alternate source or documented contingency
* Launch first-pass yield, rework and defect performance
* Completeness and accuracy of BOMs, routings, work instructions and product revisions
* Timely closure of supplier, manufacturing-readiness and lifecycle risks

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, textiles, supply chain or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing engineering, supplier development, PLM, product transfer or contract manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience moving physical products from prototype through pilot and into production.
* Experience working directly with external manufacturers or suppliers.
* Working knowledge of BOMs, routings, work instructions, engineering changes and configuration control.
* Experience with ERP/MRP and PLM or related product-data systems.
* Strong project planning, follow-through, problem-solving and written communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Round Rock and travel approximately 25%-35%.
* U.S. citizenship required due to the defense-related nature of the company’s work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technical textiles, sewn products, outdoor equipment, military products, automotive soft goods, medical textiles, inflatables or related manufacturing.
* Experience with cut-and-sew production methods, patterns, line balancing or labor standards.
* Experience with coated, laminated, printed or metallized fabrics.
* Defense, aerospace or government-contract manufacturing experience.
* Experience qualifying secondary suppliers or developing business-continuity plans.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS or similar certification.

**Working Style**

* Hands-on and comfortable working at supplier facilities and on production floors
* Organized, practical and attentive to manufacturing details
* Able to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, supplier managers and company leadership
* Persistent in following actions through completion
* Comfortable balancing several product introductions and production issues at the same time
* Focused on building useful processes without unnecessary bureaucracy
